About Mr Ahmed

Guided by Mr Ahmed Abo Mazen

English Instructor & Founder of Englishine

With more than 18 years of experience in teaching English, Mr Ahmed Abo Mazen helps students understand English through a clear, practical, and structured learning approach.

His method focuses on simplifying English concepts, making them easy to understand and remember, and connecting what students learn to real-life English. Through clear explanations, practical training, question-solving, continuous correction, and regular follow-up, students are guided with a study plan that matches their level and learning needs.

01

Clear Explanation

Complex concepts are simplified into clear, organized steps.

02

Practical Training

Students practise through examples, questions, assignments, and real-use situations.

03

Mistake Correction

Common mistakes are corrected continuously to improve accuracy and answers.

04

Personal Follow-up

Regular guidance supports a clearer study plan.

“I don't just teach English; I make it simple, practical, and easy to use.”Mr Ahmed Abo Mazen · English Instructor & Founder of Englishine
